hero.title: Connecting you to better health
hero.body: Mero Health connects patients and care providers for medical care, mental health, chronic condition management and more.
hero.artCaption: Photograph a paper report and it becomes a health record you can actually read, in your own language, tracked over time.
hero.trustTwo: Your consent before anything is shared

services.heading: The care you need, when you need it
services.body: Start from one place, whether it is an everyday complaint or a long-term condition.

care247.title: 24/7 Care
care247.body: Talk to a medical provider any time, day or night — from a common cold to an urgent worry.

primaryCare.title: Primary Care
primaryCare.body: Stay on top of your health with board-certified providers, building a relationship with one clinician.

mentalHealth.title: Mental Health
mentalHealth.body: Access a network of licensed therapists and psychiatrists — private, and in your own language.

conditionManagement.title: Condition Management
conditionManagement.body: Personalised coaching, connected devices and continuous support for long-term conditions.

specialtyCare.title: Specialty Care
specialtyCare.body: Consult specialists, from dermatology through to a second opinion on a complex diagnosis.

healthyHabits.title: Everyday healthy habits
healthyHabits.body: Small, durable steps for nutrition, sleep and habits that hold over the long run.

organizations.heading: Turning virtual care into a catalyst for better health
organizations.body: We make it easier for health plans, employers and hospitals to reach the people they serve.

healthPlans.label: Health Plans
healthPlans.title: Get members to the right care sooner
healthPlans.body: Simplify the member journey, reduce avoidable visits and improve outcomes.
healthPlans.imageAlt: A person talking to a care provider on a mobile phone

employers.label: Employers
employers.title: A real investment in employee health
employers.body: Give your team care without leaving work — from the office, from home, or from the district.
employers.imageAlt: Two colleagues reviewing a tablet in an office

hospitals.label: Hospitals & Health Systems
hospitals.title: Extend your own service with virtual reach
hospitals.body: Bring your team's capability to places where specialists are scarce.
hospitals.imageAlt: A patient in a hospital bed speaking with a virtual provider

testimonials.heading: Helping people live their healthiest lives

sabina.quote: I photographed the report and understood the result in Nepali straight away. I no longer have to ask a doctor every time.
sabina.name: Sabina (fictional example)

raju.quote: All of my father's old reports are in one place. We don't carry a folder to the hospital any more.
raju.name: Raju (fictional example)

mina.quote: Asking in my own language made it far less daunting. The answer shows its sources too.
mina.name: Mina (fictional example)

prakash.quote: I can finally see what my sugar levels have done over months, all in one place.
prakash.name: Prakash (fictional example)
